title: The final submission package
idea: A final submission is the complete, self-checking package of your design: requirements, diagrams, runnable code with passing checks, and a short record of decisions.
points: Each artefact proves one thing a reviewer would otherwise have to ask.
The code must run from a clean folder with one command.
Diagrams must match the code: same class names, same method signatures.
The Key decisions section of DESIGN.md says why, so reviewers need not guess.

hero.caption: Read the last column as your final checklist: a reviewer will test each line.

pitfalls: Update the diagrams after the last refactor, or they will contradict the code.
Run the submission from a fresh copy, not from the folder you worked in.
takeaway: Submit only what a stranger can run, read and verify alone.
